Subject: Re: Quick ask — SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team wants a short walkthrough focused on SOC 2 scope and DPA implications before we move to procurement. Ideally 45 minutes to cover architecture, evidence locations, and the pen test timeline.

We're aiming for next week (May 10–12). Broad availability below:
- Tue 10 May: 09:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 11 May: 15:00–18:00 PT (preferred for us)
- Thu 12 May: 08:00–10:00 PT

Could you propose a slot and confirm what evidence artifacts we'll need to prepare? Also, procurement has flagged a "contract gating" check — they want a short note from Legal confirming DPA terms before we share any pen-test tasking. Is that something Redwood can provide on short notice?

Best,
Sarah
Security Program Manager, Arcadia Financial

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear availability and the scope doc.

We can do a 45-minute focused walkthrough. Proposed options from our side that map to your windows:
- Tue 10 May, 10:00 PT — 45m (engineer + compliance lead)
- Wed 11 May, 16:00 PT — 45m (preferred to match your note)
- Thu 12 May, 09:00 PT — 45m (backup)

On evidence: I'll attach a short checklist (e.g., SOC 2 control owners, S3 evidence paths, retention policy excerpt, and where audit logs sit). For the pen test gating: we can provide a DPA summary and a Legal point-of-contact for a quick confirmation note — that usually satisfies procurement to unblock a pen-test kickoff.

Ben, Neha — can you confirm if Legal can produce a one-paragraph gating confirmation for Arcadia this week? If so, I'll draft a calendar invite and include the checklist and a DocuSign link for the DPA (redwood-dpa-summary.pdf attached).

If Wed 11 at 16:00 PT works, I'll lock it and send a calendar invitation with a Zoom bridge and pre-read.

Thanks — Vanessa
